levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Opening line is vague, missing what is needed or roughly when (e.g., 'I need an appointment').

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Opening line states what is needed and roughly when in one clear sentence.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Opening line also anticipates a likely follow-up question a scheduler would ask.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Questions are generic and would apply to any appointment of any kind.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two of three questions are specific to preparing for this particular appointment.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All three questions are specific and would change how the learner prepares.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection is generic ('I feel ready now') with no specific part named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names one specific part they feel ready for and one they'd still want help with.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Explains specifically why that one part is still hard, not just that it is.

lookFors: No real health condition, provider name, or personal medical detail appears anywhere in the response.
The opening line names what is needed and a rough timeframe, not just an intent to schedule.
The reflection is specific and honest rather than a blanket statement of confidence.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
